_: Logo animations as data. Units: ms for time; dx/dy in cells (one cell = 1/8 of the mark); scale around the element's centre; tint 0..1 blends toward the counter colour (frame → accent, corner → ink, glyph → accent). Orders for cells: reading, columns, clockwise, counter, ring, from-corner, to-corner, from-center, random (a fresh order every run) or random:<seed> (fixed). Orders for glyphs: ltr, rtl, center-out, edges-in, random:<seed>. A track holds its first keyframe before it starts and its last after it ends unless before/after is "none"; wrap runs it modulo the animation duration. Target "pixels" takes an "art": eight rows of eight characters, "#" lit, "." dark — the pixel layer is invisible at rest and sits on the whole 8×8 grid; orders: reading, columns, from-center, from-corner, random:<seed>. A pixels track may "morph" into "mark", "corner" or "frame": every lit pixel gets a nearest free cell, and the keyframe prop "move" (0..1) walks it there. Targets "landed"/"unlanded" are the cells a morph track of the same animation hands over to, and the others. "accent" (0..1) blends toward the brand petrol. A morph track with "colour": "landing" tints pixels bound for the corner petrol on the way. An animation may name a colour role in "highlight" ("success", "danger", … from tokens/base.json): that is what its "tint" blends toward, resolved per surface in light and dark, and a highlight passed to the player still wins. Sounds are specs, not files: "sounds" holds named tones (notes played in order, each a frequency in hertz and a length in ms, optionally gliding to a second frequency with "to"; "gain" 0..1, "wave" sine/triangle/square/sawtooth), and an animation's "cues" fire them as the playhead passes: {"at": ms, "haptic": light/medium/heavy/selection, "sound": <tone name>}. Both are silent until a player is asked for them.
